_meta.note: The other half of the mount, and a hazard rather than a capability. The same session/new with one element whose command cannot start does NOT fail: the session is created normally, in the required mode, with the offending element silently dropped. So one pooled broker stub that cannot start costs no session here -- and leaves a healthy-looking session carrying none of Crew's tools, which is the state an outright failure never produces. This is the inverse of a harness that fails session/new whole and names the server. Reductions: ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; catalog cut as in the handshake file; session_info_update and available_commands_update dropped.
